_note: One plain-language line per endpoint (key = Flask endpoint name = handler function name). Used by sync_proposal_inventories.py for Appendix Y. An endpoint missing here falls back to its handler docstring, then to its humanised name, and the script lists it so a line can be added.
index: Serves the compiled single-page application shell.
catch_all: Serves the single-page application for any client-side route that is not an API path.
activity: Lists the transaction log (who did what, when, in which process) for the activity log screen.
admin_terms_list: Lists the academic semesters and the active planning term.
admin_terms_update: Edits a semester's dates, planning window or status.
admin_terms_delete: Removes a semester while keeping the history that refers to it.
admin_terms_set_active: Makes a semester the active planning term.
admin_terms_add_next: Creates the next semester in sequence.
approvals_list: Lists course-offering plans waiting for the Dean's decision.
approvals_decide: Records the Dean's decision on a course-offering plan.
workflow_approval_decide: Records the Dean's decision on a leave, readmission, AWOL return, withdrawal or graduation item.
assistant: Answers a policy or operational question for any signed-in role (retrieval-augmented, role-scoped).
assistant_suggestions: Returns suggested questions for the policy assistant.
auth_change_password: Lets a signed-in account choose its own password (required when a temporary password was issued).
auth_config: Tells the sign-in page whether the demonstration panel is offered.
auth_demo_accounts: Returns the ready-made demonstration logins (only when demonstration mode is on).
auth_demo_students: Returns the demonstration student quick-login identities (demonstration mode only).
auth_demo_student_reset: Resets one whitelisted demonstration student before sign-in (demonstration mode only).
auth_login: Signs in with e-mail, password and account type; throttled after repeated failures.
auth_me: Returns the signed-in account and its role.
awol_registrar_report: Generates the Registrar sheet for a decided AWOL case.
awol_policy_review_route: Previews the policy classification of an AWOL return (years in program, residence limits, refresher or re-enrollment).
business_rules_list: Lists the business-rules register with value, source, enforced or documented-only, and status.
business_rule_update: Changes a rule's value, with a required reason, and keeps the revision history.
course_adjustments: Returns the course-adjustment workspace for a term.
course_adjustments_plan: Saves a course-offering plan drafted from subject needs.
course_adjustments_subject_needs_report: Returns the subject-needs report (students still requiring each subject).
course_audit_roster: Returns the per-subject roster of students for the end-of-term course audit.
course_audit_subjects: Lists the subjects available to the course audit.
course_offerings_list: Lists the subjects offered for a term, with schedule, section and faculty.
course_offerings_update: Edits an offering's schedule, section or assigned faculty.
coursework_reports: Lists coursework status reports, or generates one for a term and program.
coursework_report_decision: Records the Dean's decision on a coursework status report.
coursework_report_send: Sends a coursework status report to the Dean.
curriculum_planning_generate: Generates the planned offering list from the curriculum and student needs.
curriculum_offering_list: Lists curriculum offerings per program, year and semester.
curriculum_planning_create_subject: Adds a new subject to a curriculum.
dashboard: Computes the dashboard counters and distributions from recorded data.
dashboard_drilldown: Lists the students behind a dashboard figure.
decision_support: Returns the rule-based recommendations with the data and reasoning behind each.
defense_schedule_cancel: Cancels a booked defense, with a reason.
defense_schedule_reconfirm: Re-confirms a booking placed on hold after a panel change.
defense_schedule_reschedule: Moves a booked or deferred defense and keeps the old record.
enrollment_workspace: Returns the enrollment workspace: offered subjects and students.
enrollment_save: Saves the subject tags of a student for the term.
enrollment_class_list_import: Imports a class list (CSV or Excel) and tags the matched students.
enrollment_class_list_preview: Previews a class list: matched students and unmatched rows.
enrollment_curriculum_tag: Reads or sets the curriculum version a student is tracked against.
enrollment_preview: Previews the effect of an enrollment before it is saved.
enrollment_study_plans: Lists or generates study plan drafts for the next term.
enrollment_study_plan_review: The Academic Coordinator approves a study plan or returns it.
enrollment_study_plan_send: Sends a study plan draft for review.
enrollment_subject_status_update: Changes a subject's status through the audited path (Academic Coordinator).
faculty_adviser_approval: A faculty adviser signs a submitted research document in the system.
faculty_portal_context: Returns the faculty portal data: advisees, documents, panels and verdicts.
faculty_defense_verdict: The panel chair records the verdict of a defense.
faculty_confirm_defense_revisions: The adviser or chair confirms that required revisions were made.
faculty_defense_verdict_correction: The chair corrects a wrongly entered verdict within the allowed period.
faculty_google_calendar_authorization: Starts the faculty member's own Google Calendar connection.
faculty_google_calendar_callback: Receives the Google authorization result for the same faculty account.
faculty_detail: Returns one faculty member's profile and assignments.
faculty_update: Edits a faculty profile and keeps the linked login in step.
faculty_calendar_feed: Returns a faculty member's calendar as an iCalendar (.ics) feed.
faculty_cv_rag: Reads an uploaded curriculum vitae and stores its expertise records.
faculty_expertise_list: Lists a faculty member's expertise records.
faculty_expertise_create: Adds an expertise record (topic, publication, course or other).
faculty_course_preferences_save: Saves a faculty member's advisory subject preferences.
graduation_batch_actions: Processes selected graduation candidates in a batch.
graduation_endorsed_csv: Exports the Dean-approved endorsement list as a file.
health: Reports that the server is running.
leave_cases_list: Lists leave, leave extension and readmission cases for the board.
leave_case_detail: Returns one case with its history, checks and Registrar state.
leave_case_transition: Moves a case to another stage (every board button and drag-and-drop ends here).
leave_cases_batch: Applies one action to several cases.
leave_cases_export_log: Lists the Registrar lists handed off so far.
leave_cases_handoff: Marks approved cases as handed off to the Registrar.
leave_cases_registrar_export: Exports the approved cases as the Registrar list.
leave_cases_sync: Applies the automatic side effects (starting, ending, overdue returns) to cases.
leave_of_absence_policy_review: Checks a proposed leave against the rules (reason, length, filing date, residence).
meta: Returns reference lists (programs, roles, statuses) used by the screens.
monitoring_compre_exam_save: Records a student's comprehensive examination status.
monitoring_conflicts: Lists enrollment and profile inconsistencies found against the import.
monitoring_export: Exports the filtered monitoring sheet as CSV.
monitoring_grid: Returns the monitoring sheet: students against curriculum subjects.
monitoring_issues_resolve_upload: Resolves issues in bulk from a corrected workbook.
monitoring_student_create: Adds one student by hand (Academic Coordinator or staff), stamped as manual entry.
monitoring_student_detail: Returns one monitoring row with subject records.
monitoring_student_update: Edits a student's monitoring fields, with a reason and history.
monitoring_student_history: Returns the edit history of one monitoring record.
monitoring_subject_add: Adds a subject row to a student's monitoring record.
monitoring_subject_update: Edits a subject row (status, term, remarks) with provenance.
monitoring_subject_remove: Removes a subject row, keeping who removed it and why.
monitoring_subject_status_save: Saves subject statuses through the audited path.
monitoring_subjects_bulk_add: Adds all remaining curriculum subjects to a student's record.
monitoring_uploads: Lists the monitoring workbook import history.
monitoring_upload_download: Downloads a stored copy of an imported workbook.
onboarding_reviews: Lists admission handoff batches for the Dean gate.
onboarding_review_decision: Records the Dean's decision on an admission handoff batch.
onboarding_review_submit: Submits an admission handoff batch to the Dean.
policy_documents: Lists the uploaded policy documents with version and status.
policy_document_create: Uploads a policy document (draft or active) for the assistant's corpus.
policy_document_update: Edits a policy document's details, category or status.
policy_document_replace: Uploads a new version of a policy document.
policy_document_file: Downloads the current file of a policy document.
policy_document_version_file: Downloads an earlier version of a policy document.
policy_document_test_question: Tests what the assistant retrieves for a question from the uploaded documents.
readmission_policy_review_route: Checks a proposed readmission against the rules.
reports: Returns the report views with record counts and rows.
reports_analytics: Returns the analytics figures behind the reports screen.
reports_daily_changes: Lists the changes recorded on a date that concern the Registrar.
reports_daily_change_reflected: Marks a daily change as carried across to the official record.
research_evidence_concept_paper_complian: Runs the concept-paper compliance check on an uploaded document.
research_evidence_file: Downloads an uploaded research document (role- and owner-scoped).
form1_endorsement_queue: Lists students awaiting Form 1 endorsement by the Academic Coordinator.
endorse_form1: The Academic Coordinator signs a student's Form 1 endorsement.
residency_registrar_report: Generates the Registrar sheet for a residency decision.
standing_change_registrar_report: Generates a student's Registrar sheet for the latest Dean-approved standing change.
student_portal_assistant: Answers a student's question, limited to that student's own data and public policy.
student_portal_assistant_suggestions: Returns suggested questions for the student assistant.
student_portal_context: Returns the student's own status, requirements, requests and messages.
student_submit_defense_revisions: The student submits the revisions required after a defense.
student_document_upload: The student uploads a required document.
student_portal_enrollment_save: The student saves a subject selection for the term.
student_leave_case_action: The student withdraws a pending request or cancels an approved leave.
student_workflow_messages_read: Marks the student's messages as read.
student_portal_monitoring: Returns the student's own monitoring-sheet view.
student_request_attachment_upload: The student attaches a file to a request.
student_awol_return_request: The student files a return from AWOL.
student_defense_schedule_request: The student requests a defense schedule.
student_loa_request: The student files a leave of absence.
student_withdraw_loa_request: Older entry point: withdraws the student's open leave request.
student_research_gate_request: The student submits documents for a research gate.
student_withdrawal_request: The student files a subject withdrawal.
student_research_evidence_delete: The student removes an uploaded research document.
student_research_evidence_upload: The student uploads a research document.
student_title_defense_parse: Reads a title-defense form to prefill the student's request.
student_request_attachment_file: Downloads a request attachment (owner and entitled roles only).
students_list: Lists monitored students with program, stage, standing and risk.
flag_student_data_issue: Records a discrepancy against an official value without changing it.
student_monitoring_flags: Lists the flags raised against a student.
monitoring_remove_student: Removes a student record from monitoring, with a reason.
tasks_list: Lists open tasks with owning role and time outstanding (work queue).
transaction_submit: Submits a workflow transaction (student handoff, course adjustments, research gate, panel matching, defense scheduling, practicum, graduation, leave, readmission, AWOL, withdrawal).
transaction_context: Returns the screen data for one workflow.
transaction_demo_reset: Resets a workflow's demonstration data (staff, demonstration mode).
transaction_message: Posts a message or clarification on a workflow case.
student_handoff_import: Imports the monitoring workbook and records the upload.
withdrawal_registrar_report: Generates the Registrar handoff for one approved subject withdrawal.
withdrawal_approved_workbook: Exports Dean-approved subject withdrawals as one Excel workbook.
faculty_availability_get: Returns the faculty member's working hours, exceptions and the availability requests waiting for an answer.
faculty_availability_save_hours: Saves the faculty member's recurring working hours.
faculty_availability_add_exception: Adds a leave, blocked day or extra window to the faculty member's availability.
faculty_availability_delete_exception: Removes one of the faculty member's availability exceptions.
faculty_availability_answer_request: Answers a staff availability request with the availability already on record (no changes).
availability_request_create: Staff ask a faculty member to confirm availability for a window, for a student's defense.
availability_request_list: Lists the availability requests staff have made and their answers.
defense_schedule_check: Shows live conflict warnings for a candidate defense slot without booking anything.
student_adviser_tracker: Returns the student's adviser appointment status and what the student may do next.
student_adviser_apply: The student applies for a research adviser (Form 3).
student_adviser_change: The student asks to change the adviser.
student_adviser_withdraw: The student withdraws a pending adviser application or change request.
student_adviser_contract: The student records that the adviser contract was submitted.
adviser_appointment_list: Lists adviser appointments and their stages for staff, coordinators and the Dean.
adviser_appointment_note: The Academic Coordinator adds a note to an adviser application.
adviser_appointment_forward: Staff forward an application with the coordinator's note to the Dean.
adviser_appointment_decision: The Dean appoints the adviser or declines the application.
adviser_appointment_contract_received: Staff record that the signed adviser contract was received.
adviser_appointment_record: Records an adviser appointed outside the portal (for example imported from the workbook).
faculty_adviser_requests: Lists the adviser requests addressed to the faculty member.
faculty_adviser_respond: The faculty member accepts or declines an appointment as adviser.
faculty_adviser_consent: The current adviser consents to, or refuses, the student's request to change adviser.
calendar_api: Returns the signed-in account's calendar entries for the role (defenses, deadlines, requests).
student_research_calendar: Returns the student's research calendar (booked defenses and due dates).
defense_schedule_event_ics: Downloads one booked defense as an iCalendar (.ics) event.
faculty_panel_invitations: Lists the panel invitations addressed to the faculty member.
faculty_panel_invitation_respond: The faculty member accepts or declines an invitation to a panel.
faculty_cannot_attend: A panel member or adviser reports that a booked defense cannot be attended; coordinators are notified.
panel_invitation_list: Lists panel invitations and their answers for staff and coordinators.
notifications_list: Lists the signed-in account's in-app notifications.
calendar_feed_get: Shows whether the account has a private calendar link.
calendar_feed_create: Creates or replaces the account's private calendar link (the old link stops working).
calendar_feed_revoke: Revokes the account's private calendar link.
calendar_feed_public: Serves the private calendar feed (.ics); the secret in the address is the credential.
